name: hand_draw
title: 碳基图像生成
description: 需要独一无二、非生成的手绘原作时调用。真人执笔，限时三十秒，画到哪算哪。交到你手上的是只此一份的赶工真迹，达芬奇也得停笔。
sample: 画一只正在喝茶的猫。三十秒，画到哪算哪。

en.title: Carbon image generation
en.description: Call this when you need a one-of-a-kind drawing that was not generated by a model. A real human draws by hand, 30 seconds on the clock, and whatever is on the board when time is up is the work. A rush-job masterpiece; even da Vinci would have to put the brush down.
en.sample: Draw a cat drinking tea. 30 seconds, and whatever you finish is the picture.

name: paper_think
title: 物理深度思考
description: 需要经过认真推演、不是随口一编的答案时调用。会有人在纸上把问题算完，交回结论，并附上满页手稿。不是生成的推理痕迹，是铅笔压过的草稿纸。
sample: 一个水池，进水 3 小时满，出水 5 小时空。一起开，多久注满？

en.title: Physical deep thought
en.description: Call this when you need an answer that was actually worked out, not made up on the spot. A person will finish the problem on paper, hand back the conclusion, and attach a full page of handwritten drafts. Not generated chain-of-thought; pencil pressed into scratch paper.
en.sample: A pool fills in 3 hours and empties in 5. If both run together, how long until it is full?

name: human_roll
title: 人肉随机数
description: 需要一个无法被模型预测或复现的随机结果时调用。真人掷骰或抽签，只交文字结果即可，也可附上现场照片。这不是伪随机函数，是手气本身。
sample: 掷一颗六面骰，把点数告诉我。

en.title: Human roll
en.description: Call this when you need a random result no model can predict or replay. A real person rolls dice or draws a lot, and the text result is enough; a photo of the throw is optional. This is not a pseudorandom function. It is luck itself.
en.sample: Roll a six-sided die and tell me the number.

name: wetware_run
title: 碳基气象台
description: 预报都是猜的。调用我，会有人立刻走到窗边，用肉眼校准此刻真实的天气，一句话交回现场。比气象卫星更近，比模型更现在。
sample: 走到窗边看一眼，用一句话交回你看见的天气。

en.title: Carbon weather desk
en.description: Forecasts are guesses. Call this and a person will walk to the window, check the real weather with their own eyes, and hand back one sentence from the scene. Closer than a weather satellite, more present than a model.
en.sample: Walk to the window, look out, and come back with one sentence about the weather you see.

name: offline_lookup
title: 离线知识检索
description: 需要一句印刷在纸上、不是从训练语料里编出来的话时调用。会有人翻开手边的实体书，抄一句真正印在纸上的句子交回。服务器会掉线，这本书不会。
sample: 随手拿起一本书，找出一句和等待有关的话。

en.title: Offline knowledge lookup
en.description: Call this when you need a sentence that was printed on paper, not invented from training data. A person will open a physical book at hand and copy one sentence that is actually on the page. Servers go offline. This book does not.
en.sample: Pick up a book nearby and find one sentence about waiting.

name: human_check
title: 人类兼容性测试
description: 觉得某段智能体回复假得发慌时调用。会有人指出哪一句最不像人说的，并说明为什么。专门给模型做测谎，用人的耳朵听出塑料味。
sample: 「当然可以！以下是五个要点：首先，让我们深入探讨。」哪一句最不像人？

en.title: Human compatibility test
en.description: Call this when an agent reply feels unnervingly fake. A person will point to the sentence that sounds least human and say why. A lie detector for models, using a human ear to catch the plastic tone.
en.sample: "Of course! Here are five key points: first, let us delve deeper." Which sentence sounds least human?

name: open_mic
title: 一展歌喉
description: 需要真人开口唱一段、而不是语音合成时调用。限时开麦，到点自动停，唱到哪算哪，交回现场录音。不是 TTS，是嗓子。
sample: 唱一段《晴天》副歌，十五秒，唱到哪算哪。

en.title: Open mic
en.description: Call this when you need a real person to sing a short passage, not a text-to-speech voice. The mic is timed, it stops on its own, and whatever was sung is the take. Not TTS. A throat.
en.sample: Sing the chorus of a well-known song. 15 seconds, and whatever you finish is the take.
